mousemapper.title: Whole-body nerve architecture
mousemapper.description: Whole-body reconstructions of normal (left) and obese (right) UCHL1-EGFP mice. Peripheral nerves (UCHL1-EGFP+) are shown in green, bones and organs are shown in red (propidium iodide labeled) and muscle (autofluorescence) is shown in blue.
mousemapper.label: Nerves

mousemapper.title: CD68+ immune map (chow vs obese)
mousemapper.description: Whole-body reconstructions of normal (left) and obese (right) CD68-EGFP mice. Immune cells (CD68-EGFP+) are shown in cyan, bones and organs are shown in magenta (propidium iodide labeled) and muscle (autofluorescence) is shown in yellow.
mousemapper.label: Immune cells

mousemapper.title: CD68+ cells in chow-fed mouse
mousemapper.description: Whole-body reconstructions of a chow-fed CD68-EGFP mouse showing CD68-EGFP+ cells in the whole mouse. Immune cells (CD68-EGFP+) are shown in cyan, bones and organs are shown in magenta (propidium iodide labeled) and muscle (autofluorescence) is shown in yellow.
mousemapper.label: Immune · chow

mousemapper.title: CD68+ infiltration in high-fat diet
mousemapper.description: Supplementary Video 4. Whole-body reconstructions of a  HFD-fed CD68-EGFP mouse showing infiltrating CD68-EGFP+ cells in the whole mouse with accumulations in ScAT, ViscAT and the peritoneum. Immune cells (CD68-EGFP+) are shown in cyan, bones and organs are shown in magenta (propidium iodide labeled) and muscle (autofluorescence) is shown in yellow.
mousemapper.label: Immune · obese

mousemapper.title: AI organ segmentation (chow-fed)
mousemapper.description: Representative chow-fed mouse showing AI-segmented organs and tissue. Each color represents a different organ or tissue segmented using the Tissue-Module of MouseMapper.
mousemapper.label: Segmentation

mousemapper.title: AI organ segmentation (obese)
mousemapper.description: Representative obese mouse showing AI-segmented organs and tissue. Each color represents a different organ or tissue segmented using the Tissue-Module of MouseMapper.
mousemapper.label: Segmentation · obese

mousemapper.title: AI immune cell clusters
mousemapper.description: Representative obese CD68-EGFP mouse showing AI-segmented immune cell clusters (blue: small clusters, green: medium-sized clusters, red: large-sized clusters).
mousemapper.label: Immune clusters

wilddisco.title: PGP 9.5 peripheral nerve map
wilddisco.description: 3D reconstruction of a mouse labeled with PGP 9.5 and imaged with light-sheet microscopy. Different PGP 9.5 innervation regions (green) are visualized with high contrast over background (gray).

wilddisco.title: Heart innervation
wilddisco.description: 3D view of PGP 9.5 positive peripheral nerve in mouse heart showing in magenta.
wilddisco.label: Heart

wilddisco.title: Sympathetic nerves in spleen
wilddisco.description: 3D visualization of sympathetic nerve in mouse spleen labeled with tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) in magenta.
wilddisco.label: Spleen

wilddisco.title: Liver & gallbladder nerves
wilddisco.description: 3D visualization of mouse liver and gallbladder innervated with PGP 9.5 positive peripheral nerves in magenta.
wilddisco.label: Liver

wilddisco.title: Intestinal sympathetic nerves
wilddisco.description: 3D annotation of mouse intestinal innervation with TH positive nerve in magenta. Grid-like lattice structures can be seen in the intestinal wall.
wilddisco.label: Gut

wilddisco.title: Vagus nerve multi-organ connections
wilddisco.description: 3D annotation of neuronal connections in multiple organs (kidney, spleen, liver, and intestine) labeled with PGP 9.5 in green.
wilddisco.label: Vagus

wilddisco.title: Whole-body lymphatic vasculature
wilddisco.description:
3D visualization of the entire lymphatic vessels in the whole mouse. The lymphatic vessels of a 4-weekold
mouse were labeled with LYVE1 in yellow.
wilddisco.label: Lymphatics

wilddisco.title: Hind limb lymphatics & nodes
wilddisco.description:
3D visualization of the hind limb of a mouse with LYVE1 lymphatic vessel labeling in yellow. Fine
details of the lymphatic vessels and lymph nodes are shown.
wilddisco.label: Hind limb

wilddisco.title: Kidney lymphatic vessels
wilddisco.description: 3D visualization of mouse kidney with LYVE1 lymphatic vessels labeled in yellow.
wilddisco.label: Kidney

wilddisco.title: Stomach lymphatic network
wilddisco.description: 3D annotation of mouse stomach with LYVE1 lymphatic vessels highlighted in yellow. The fine details of the lymphatic vessels are clearly visible throughout the scan.
wilddisco.label: Stomach

wilddisco.title: Intestinal lymphatics & node
wilddisco.description: 3D annotation of mouse intestine lymphatic vessels with yellow color labeled by LYVE1 and scanned with light-sheet microscopy. Fine details of the lymphatic vessels can be seen in the intestine and a lymph node is located adjacent to the intestine.
wilddisco.label: Intestine

wilddisco.title: Lymphatics in intestinal wall
wilddisco.description: 3D view of the intestinal wall of a mouse with LYVE1 lymphatic vessels labeled in yellow.
wilddisco.label: Intestinal wall

wilddisco.title: Lymphatic vessels in cortex
wilddisco.description: wildDISCO staining of PROX1 lymphatic vessels in green and arterial staining of alpha-SMA in red, revealing lymphatic vessels penetrated in mouse cerebral cortex.
wilddisco.label: Brain cortex

wilddisco.title: Lymphatic capillaries on brain
wilddisco.description: 3D illustration showing wildDISCO staining of LYVE1 in yellow and podoplanin in magenta to visualize lymphatic capillaries covered on the surface of the mouse brain, and also entering the brain parenchyma around thalamus.
wilddisco.label: Brain surface

wilddisco.title: Sympathetic nerves & immune cells
wilddisco.description: 3D illustration showing innervation of intestinal lymph nodes by sympathetic neurons using TH staining to label sympathetic nerves in magenta and CD45 staining to label immune cells in green.
wilddisco.label: Gut · immunity

wilddisco.title: Immune cells on intestinal neurons
wilddisco.description: Representative 3D reconstructions of immune cells on the intestine neurons. CD45 is stained in green for immune cell distribution and TH stained in magenta for sympathetic nerves.
wilddisco.label: Gut · neurons

wilddisco.title: Sympathetic–lymphatic whole body
wilddisco.description: 3D reconstruction of a TH and LYVE1 labeled mouse by light sheet microscopy. Different regions of sympathetic nerve innervation in green and lymphatic vessels in blue can be seen.
wilddisco.label: Nerves & lymph

wilddisco.title: Sympathetic–lymphatic on gut wall
wilddisco.description: 3D illustration of the TH stained sympathetic nerve in green interacting with LYVE1-labeled lymphatic vessels in yellow on the intestinal wall.
wilddisco.label: Gut wall

wilddisco.title: Sympathetic–lymphatic in intestine
wilddisco.description: 3D illustration of TH+ sympathetic nerve (green) interacting with LYVE1+ lymphatic vessels (yellow) inside the intestine.
wilddisco.label: Inside intestine

wilddisco.title: Whole-body lymph node distribution
wilddisco.description: 3D illustration showing the distribution of multiple lymph nodes throughout the mouse. Innervation of pan-neuron markers PGP 9.5 in green and lymph node masked color in cyan.
wilddisco.label: Lymph nodes

wilddisco.title: Posterior limb lymph node nerves
wilddisco.description: Representative 3D illustration of a posterior limb lymph node innervated by PGP 9.5 positive nerves in green and PROX1 positive lymph nodes in magenta.
wilddisco.label: Limb node

wilddisco.title: Myenteric nerves (germ-free)
wilddisco.description: 3D illustration showing PGP 9.5 staining of myenteric nerves in green from germ-free mouse gut. In germ-free mice, the myenteric plexus appears disorganized in some regions of the gut wall, with fewer ganglia and thinner nerve connecting fibers.
wilddisco.label: Germ-free gut

wilddisco.title: Homogeneous whole-body staining
wilddisco.description: Summary of results showing a homogeneous and simultaneous antibody staining throughout the entire mouse bodies.
wilddisco.label: Staining

wilddisco.title: VR multi-organ nerve connections
wilddisco.description: 3D VR visualization of neuronal connections in multiple organs labeled with PGP 9.5 in green and masked colors for kidney, spleen, liver, and intestine.
wilddisco.label: VR · organs

wilddisco.title: VR intestinal innervation
wilddisco.description: 3D VR visualization of mouse intestinal innervation with TH positive nerve in magenta referred to Movie S5. Grid-like structures can be clearly visible throughout the intestinal wall.
wilddisco.label: VR · gut

disco-ms.title: DISCO-MS pipeline on 5xFAD brain
disco-ms.description: Step-by-step DISCO-MS pipeline illustrated on a 5xFAD mouse brain (6 weeks old). LCM extracted ROIs around the single plaques subjected to ultra-high sensitive mass spectrometry based proteome analyses.
disco-ms.label: Pipeline

disco-ms.title: Robotic ROI extraction workflow
disco-ms.description: Robotic arm illustration showing the steps of extraction from DISCO/SHANEL cleared whole mouse and large human organs. DISCO-bot uses the biopsy needles of various sizes to extract the ROIs for the subsequent molecular analysis.
disco-ms.label: DISCO-bot

disco-ms.title: Microglia after mild brain injury
disco-ms.description: vDISCO labeled and cleared CX3CR1-EGFP brain showing microglia activation in a region-specific manner after mTBI compared to sham. Particularly, highlighted regions are along the corpus callosum and optic tract (segmented microglia in magenta).
disco-ms.label: mTBI

disco-ms.title: AI-segmented plaques in Alzheimer model
disco-ms.description: 5xFAD whole mouse brain showing deep learning-based segmentation of plaques at later stage of disease (6 months old).
disco-ms.label: Amyloid plaques

disco-ms.title: Real-time scapula extraction
disco-ms.description: Robotic arm guided real time extraction of ROIs from bone marrow of scapula in mouse. The procedure involves 4 major steps: 1) Finding the target of interest and approaching with needle 2) cutting through bone to reach the marrow 3) excising around the target and extracting the tissue with vacuum, and 4) examining the extracted area to ensure successful extraction.
disco-ms.label: Bone marrow

disco-ms.title: LysM+ immune ROIs across mouse
disco-ms.description: DISCO-bot ROIs extraction from the scapula and cranium of a LysM-EGFP mouse cleared with vDISCO. LysM immune cells are shown in magenta; PI labelled nuclei are in yellow and autofluorescence is in cyan.
disco-ms.label: Whole body

disco-ms.title: Coronary atherosclerotic plaques
disco-ms.description: Atherosclerotic human heart after SHANEL clearing and imaging, showing the plaque vs. non-plaque regions along the right coronary artery. Plaques are segmented in gold; vessels are in magenta and autofluorescence is in cyan.
disco-ms.label: Heart

shanel.title: Beta cells in pig pancreas
shanel.description: SHANEL histology revealed individual or groups of beta cells within islets of INS-EGFP transgenic pig pancreas that is several centimeters in size. 3D reconstruction of nanobody boosted EGFP transgenic pancreas imaged by light-sheet microscopy. After SHANEL, all labelled beta cells became evident in the islets throughout the pancreas. In the second part of the movie, segmented EGFP+ islets are shown.
shanel.label: Pancreas

shanel.title: Intact human eye in 3D
shanel.description: 3D reconstruction of intact human eye imaged by light-sheet microscopy. SHANEL technology revealed structural details of sclera, iris and suspensory ligament in intact human eye.
shanel.label: Human eye

shanel.title: Abeta plaques in aged human brain
shanel.description: Upright confocal microscopy imaging of 0.4 cm thickness of a human brain slice with the cellular resolution (before clearing size: 10 x 7 x 1.5 cm; after clearing size 7.5 x 5 x 1.1 cm). The large scan shows the Abeta plaques are heavily accumulated in specific cortex regions including middle temporal gyrus (MTG) and cingulate gyrus (CG).
shanel.label: Brain · plaques

shanel.title: Microglia across human brain tissue
shanel.description: 3D reconstruction of Iba1 antibody labeled microglia cells were evident throughout the centimeters size human brain tissue imaged by light-sheet microscopy. Individual microglia across the gray matter and white matter showed ramified and unramified morphological differences.
shanel.label: Microglia

shanel.title: TH+ neuronal processes in human brain
shanel.description: 3D reconstruction of Tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) antibody labeled neuronal processes were evident throughout centimeters size human brain tissue imaged by light-sheet microscopy. Individual axonal extension across the gray matter and white matter were visible.
shanel.label: Neurons

shanel.title: Human kidney glomeruli & vessels
shanel.description: 3D reconstruction of human kidney cortex showing TRITC-dextran labeled vessels and TO-PRO-3 labeled glomeruli structures, imaged by light-sheet microscopy. Individual glomerulus was tracked by afferent arteriole. Structural profiles of cortex were characterized by the width, glomerular capillary diameter and afferent arteriole diameter.
shanel.label: Kidney

vessap.label: Segmentation

vessap.description: Substack of the whole brain data registered to the Allen adult brain atlas. This video reveals the full resolution segmentation on a small set of the brain scans data.
vessap.label: High resolution

vessap.title: Capillary-level vasculature detail
vessap.description: Capillary-level vasculature segmentation across the whole brain dataset, registered to the Allen adult brain atlas.
vessap.label: Capillaries

deepmact.title: Torso metastasis mapping
deepmact.description: 3D reconstruction of a mouse torso scanned by light-sheet microscopy. The left side shows the segmented view, in which the torso is represented in gray, the lungs in yellow and the heart in green. The right side shows the original 2D data from the light-sheet microscopy. Various macro- and micro-metastases (magenta) are visualized in high contrast over the background.
deepmact.label: Whole body

deepmact.title: Lung micrometastases
deepmact.description: 3D visualization of some micrometastases in the lungs obtained by light-sheet microscopy. The tumors are shown in magenta and PI nuclear labeling in green.
deepmact.label: Lung

deepmact.title: Therapeutic antibody biodistribution
deepmact.description: 3D animation of a mouse body scanned by light-sheet microscopy. The outline of the mouse (scan of the unlabeled autofluorescence channel at 488 nm excitation) is shown in gray, some segmented organs (lungs, kidney, liver and brain) in blue, the tumors in magenta, and the tumor & therapeutic antibody 6A10 co-localization in white. The first part of the animation shows tumor macro- and micrometastasis throughout the body, and the second part shows the biodistribution of the therapeutic antibody 6A10 along with tumor macro- and micrometastases.
deepmact.label: Antibody

deepmact.title: Antibody binding at micrometastases
deepmact.description: 3D animation of the lungs demonstrating the details of the therapeutic antibody binding. Micrometastases are shown in magenta and the co-localization of micrometastases and therapeutic antibody in white. While most of the micrometastases were targeted by the therapeutic antibody (white), a fraction was not (the ones remaining magenta throughout the movie).
deepmact.label: Lung binding
